statement: A test count copied from an agent's report is a claim about the head that agent ran, not about the head you hand back. Incident: the reviewing session's hand-back for cejel #645 at 1618abbc4 said "Full suite: 6,722 passed, 2 skipped", a figure copied from the fixer agent's report, and gave the operator a merge plan on it. The session did not run the suite at 1618abbc4. CI's build-test then failed there: src/__tests__/bare-npx-invocation-guard.test.ts refused two leaderboard/RUBRIC_CHANGELOG.md lines (240, 260) that spelled a fixture as npx followed by ./jest, text from the round's records. CI counted 6,721 passed and 1 failed. Fix: f0cfbba72 rewords the two lines. Rule: before a hand-back states a suite result, run the suite at the exact head named, or attribute the number to the agent and the head it ran.
